scope: Dimensionless unforced Rosenhead regularized midpoint Biot-Savart FILAMENT SURROGATE; not Euler PDE / not quantum GPE
source_selection: CPFIXED61 only; source 64 active link records; 5_5_6 and 6_6_5; no silent removal of sharp turn cases

arm_definitions.single_i: Component i extracted without geometric modification; same gamma_i, core, normalization and time
arm_definitions.pair_ij: Two components extracted without shape modification
arm_definitions.unlinked: Translate components by fixed 8 L0 steps along x; does not exactly preserve total energy or mutual interaction, interpret as geometric separation control
arm_definitions.feedback: Balanced +/- epsilon shape displacement only at t=0, no additional force

normalization: source XYZ -> center whole three-component system -> divide by RMS radius L0, dimensionless absolute gamma magnitude 1; no canonical SST quantities
holdout_policy: One frozen whole profile per composition, including all orientations and resolutions; one-way DEV/holdout; explicit lock before holdout

gates.B0: file provenance, source hash, three components, finite XYZ
gates.B1: full link isotopy, component topologies, Milnor invariant; unresolved unless independently certified
gates.B2: spacing/core <=0.25 plus core diameter below non-adjacent self-clearance and intercomponent clearance, temporal and spatial convergence
gates.B3: numerical validity, length and energy diagnostics, collision prevention; no spurious reconnection
gates.B4: long-horizon bounded relative shape / perturbation stability; never infer from short run
gates.B5: matched single/pair/triple and unlinked controls plus perturbative response
gates.B6: frequency across independently reconstructed observables, >=5 cycles and refinements
gates.B7: locked independent holdout, same criteria, no selection on outcomes
gates.B8: independent field-based Euler or GPE comparison, separate physics
gates.B9: CLOCK_CANDIDATE only if B0-B7 pass, SST proper time never asserted

stabilization_preregistered_diagnostic.rule: strict all 3 ratios <=0.95 required for strong collective diagnostic; ratios >=1.05 in all 3 suggest countereffect, else mixed/equivocal
stabilization_preregistered_diagnostic.qualification: only after spatial and time refinements, pre-specified long horizon and independent holdout; thresholds are analysis conventions, not physical constants
